fieldDescription:
Allows disabling the mod mid-save.
When true this setting disables the mod mid-save by clearing all orbits and allows you to save, exit the game, and disable the mod in the launcher or mod manager.

defaultValue: This setting changes which celestial objects can show their orbit

secondaryValue: Only Planetary Bodies,Stations Included,All Celestial Objects
fieldDescription:
Changes which celestial objects can show their orbit.
Only Planetary Bodies - Only draw orbits of planetary bodies
Stations Included - Draw orbits of planetary bodies and stations
All Celestial Objects - Draw all orbits

(Only active with the former setting set to 'Witnessed')
Changes how much total time you need to spend in a system to research a celestial object's orbit.
Full Rotation - 1 full rotation around the orbital focus (star or other planet)
Half Rotation - Half a rotation around the orbital focus
Quarter Rotation - A quarter rotation around the orbital focus

Changes the 'Course focus' Behaviour.
Highlight - Highlight the course focus' orbit
Filter - Filter the course focus' orbit, showing only that orbit
Disabled - Disables the course focus feature
Enable custom orbit trajectory color. When false uses a default color.
